messages.reasoning_content:
Looking at the error in Cell 2:

```
TypeError: only integer scalar arrays can be converted to a scalar index
```

The issue is in this line:
```python
plt.title(class_names[train_labels[i]])
```

The problem is that `train_labels[i]` is a 2D array with shape `(1,)`. When we load CIFAR-10 using `keras.datasets.cifar10.load_data()`, the labels come as 2D arrays - each label is wrapped in an array like `[array([6])]`.

So when we do `train_labels[i]`, we get something like `[[6]]` instead of just `6`. When trying to use this as an index for `class_names`, it fails.

The fix is to index properly. We can either:
1. Use `train_labels[i][0]` - get the first (and only) element of the 1-element array
2. Use `train_labels[i, 0]` - same thing using tuple indexing
3. Flatten the labels first

The simplest fix is to use `train_labels[i][0]` or `train_labels[i, 0]`.
